evals.prompt: Create a Word document called report.docx with the title 'Q1 Report' and a paragraph saying 'Revenue grew 10%.'
evals.expected_output: Python code that writes a .docx file with the requested heading and paragraph.
assertions: The response mentions python-docx or docx.Document
The response includes the literal string 'Q1 Report'
The response calls .save() with a .docx filename

evals.prompt: 워드 파일로 만들어줘. 제목은 '회의록', 본문은 '오늘 회의에서 예산 확정됨.'
evals.expected_output: Python code producing a .docx with Korean title and body.
assertions: The response includes the literal string '회의록'

evals.prompt: Convert this text into a Word doc: 'Item 1', 'Item 2', 'Item 3' as bullet points.
evals.expected_output: Python code that creates a .docx with three bullet points.
assertions: The response creates a Word document
The response includes logic for bullet list formatting
